'''Juuus''' was one of three [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] living in [[Edic Bar]]. He worked as a street sweeper, which he claimed let him know what was going on without being noticed. He also sometimes worked as hired muscle for [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], paying visits to those who tried to manipulate the corporation. It was said that he didn't leave bruises.

Juuus claimed that he used to be a pilot, but left that career after an accident nearly killed him (though nothing of this has been confirmed and Juuus is not a reliable source). As of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he was often seen wandering around Edic Bar talking to himself.
